description: Pinned upstream sources vendored into runtime/src/vendor. Refresh by copying src/*.ts (without __tests__) from the listed commit, then reapply the patches below and rerun the integration matrix.

patches.change: CellExecutionStatus also accepts 'aborted' (type-only; JupyterLab 4.6 @jupyterlab/cells returns this status).
Adds a type-only textModel() helper that casts the document model to ISharedFile before getSource/setSource (type-only; ydoc 1.x ISharedDocument omits them, JupyterLab 4.0 text files are YFile).
